text: The **Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset (JRC V4)** shows that **there was no forest** on the property in 2020 (0% tree cover). However, the **Hansen GFC (GFC-2025-v1.13)** dataset recorded **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, suggesting that forest was present before that loss occurred. Since the JRC dataset did not confirm forest in 2020, the **Hansen dataset is the one that indirectly shows forest was present earlier in 2020 before the loss event**. The corroboration rule requires both datasets to agree on ≥50% of the area, which was not met here.
